gloss: all things in heaven and earth; all of creation

definitions.gloss: all things in heaven and earth; all of creation
definitions.explanation: Everything that exists in the universe — the whole of nature and all the things within it.

examples.japanese: {天地万物|てんちばんぶつ}を{創造|そうぞう}する。
examples.english: Create all things in heaven and earth.

examples.japanese: {天地万物|てんちばんぶつ}には{命|いのち}が{宿|やど}ると{考|かんが}えられてきた。
examples.english: It has long been believed that life dwells in all things of creation.

examples.japanese: {古代|こだい}の{人々|ひとびと}は、{天地万物|てんちばんぶつ}に{神|かみ}が{宿|やど}っていると{信|しん}じていた。
examples.english: The people of ancient times believed that gods dwelled in all things of heaven and earth.

notes:
A four-character idiom ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) made of {天地|てんち} (heaven and earth) + {万物|ばんぶつ} (all things). Literary and somewhat philosophical or religious in tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天地万物|てんちばんぶつ}の{創造|そうぞう}: the creation of all things
- {天地万物|てんちばんぶつ}を{支配|しはい}する: to rule over all of creation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {森羅万象|しんらばんしょう}: all things in the universe — a close synonym, even more sweeping in scope
- {万物|ばんぶつ}: all things — the plainer component word, used on its own
